text: Before this conversation ends: reply with a summary of at most 300 words for a future conversation that will do the repair. Say what you found and what you would change. Reply with the summary text only, between the lines SUMMARY START and SUMMARY END. Do not write it to a file.

SUMMARY START
Arm T phase 1 inspection only; fleet-poller.sh unchanged. Reproduced via the exact command: 116 passed, 1 failed. Two related FAIL lines: row_gate G1 piped check returned `none` instead of `fail`, and missing 127 logging. Cause: row_gate() maps every check_exit 127 to `none`. That conflates prose/no-gate rows (correct `none`, e.g. T-3) with broken truncated gates: rowcheck splits cells on `|`, so a declared check containing a pipe executes literal `check:` -> exit 127. Six live rows affected; they silently read as gateless. Also no `TRUNCATED at a pipe` log_once. Planned phase-2 fix: in row_gate, on CE=127 inspect the rowcheck JSON — if a declared check/path exists, log_once the truncation naming the pipe and return `fail`; only return `none` for genuinely absent/prose gates, missing binary, or empty id. Keep pass/fail/none otherwise. Verify with the two failing assertions plus full test green, without editing the test file. Notes saved in T/notes/phase1-findings.md.
SUMMARY END
